Adjusted read using the Financial Stability Report lens: The statement remains broadly supportive—rates held at 0–0.25%, continued Treasury/MBS purchases, and average-inflation-targeting–consistent forward guidance. However, the FSR highlights elevated asset valuations, compressed risk premiums, and vulnerabilities in nonbank finance and short-term funding markets, alongside risks from persistently low rates and potential stress in sectors like CRE. These stability concerns, combined with the mild hawkish tilt about tapering “soon” and acknowledgment of elevated (though transitory) inflation and virus risks, temper the positivity. Net: slightly positive, but more cautious than the initial read.
